source_text: So, I’m supposed to trust you?

structure.script_literal: "TaAnDe.So, I’m supposed to trust you?"

source_text: 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: NeShOpNo1.1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "NeShOpNo1.1Hero?"

translation: 1Hero?

source_text: Nellie!?

structure.raw_value: McShClNo1.Nellie!?
structure.script_literal: "McShClNo1.Nellie!?"

translation: Nellie!?

source_text: You know each other?

structure.raw_value: CaFrOp^.You know each other?
structure.script_literal: "CaFrOp^.You know each other?"

translation: Znacie się?

source_text: What’s it going to be, 1Hero? Should I make my exit?

structure.raw_value: NeAnDe.What’s it going to be, 1Hero? Should I make my exit?
structure.script_literal: "NeAnDe.What’s it going to be, 1Hero? Should I make my exit?"

translation: Jak będzie, 1Hero? Mam już iść?

source_text: This is Nellie… She… is… a… uhh… spy.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.This is Nellie… She… is… a… uhh… spy.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.This is Nellie… She… is… a… uhh… spy."

translation: To Nellie… Ona… jest… eee… szpiegiem.

source_text: Wow! Really!?

structure.raw_value: HeShOpNo1^.Wow! Really!?
structure.script_literal: "HeShOpNo1^.Wow! Really!?"

translation: Wow! Naprawdę!?

source_text: A spy? Who ya spying on?

structure.raw_value: CaFrOp^.A spy? Who ya spying on?
structure.script_literal: "CaFrOp^.A spy? Who ya spying on?"

translation: Szpiegiem? Kogo szpiegujesz?

source_text: Don’t listen to 1Hero. He doesn’t know me as well as he thinks he does.

structure.raw_value: NeAnEx.Don’t listen to 1Hero. He doesn’t know me as well as he thinks he does.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnEx.Don’t listen to 1Hero. He doesn’t know me as well as he thinks he does."

translation: Nie słuchaj 1Hero. Wcale nie zna mnie tak dobrze, jak mu się wydaje.

source_text: This is my mom. I assume you two are 1Hero’s lesbian parents.

structure.raw_value: TaFlEx.This is my mom. I assume you two are 1Hero’s lesbian parents.
structure.script_literal: "TaFlEx.This is my mom. I assume you two are 1Hero’s lesbian parents."

translation: To moja mama. Zakładam, że wy dwie jesteście lesbijkami, które wychowują 1Hero.

source_text: Hahaha!

structure.raw_value: CaHaOpNo3^.Hahaha!
structure.script_literal: "CaHaOpNo3^.Hahaha!"

translation: Hahaha!

source_text: We’re not lovers, little lady. We’re just here with 1Hero looking for some excitement.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx^.We’re not lovers, little lady. We’re just here with 1Hero looking for some excitement.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx^.We’re not lovers, little lady. We’re just here with 1Hero looking for some excitement."

translation: Nie jesteśmy parą, młoda damo. Przyszłyśmy tu z 1Hero poszukać wrażeń.

source_text: If you know 1Hero, then you’ve got all the excitement you need.

structure.raw_value: NeFlEx.If you know 1Hero, then you’ve got all the excitement you need.
structure.script_literal: "NeFlEx.If you know 1Hero, then you’ve got all the excitement you need."

translation: Skoro znasz 1Hero, masz już dość wrażeń.

source_text: I think I know what’s going on here.

structure.raw_value: HeFlDe^.I think I know what’s going on here.
structure.script_literal: "HeFlDe^.I think I know what’s going on here."

translation: Chyba wiem, co tu się dzieje.

source_text: Tell me, Nellie. You and 1Hero ever… hook up?

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx^.Tell me, Nellie. You and 1Hero ever… hook up?
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx^.Tell me, Nellie. You and 1Hero ever… hook up?"

translation: Powiedz, Nellie… Ty i 1Hero kiedyś… ten tego?

source_text: I’m afraid not. He’s just too young for a woman like me.

structure.raw_value: NeFlEx.I’m afraid not. He’s just too young for a woman like me.
structure.script_literal: "NeFlEx.I’m afraid not. He’s just too young for a woman like me."

translation: Niestety nie. Jest po prostu za młody dla takiej kobiety jak ja.

source_text: Are you kidding me? Look at that gorgeous face!

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx^.Are you kidding me? Look at that gorgeous face!
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx^.Are you kidding me? Look at that gorgeous face!"

translation: Żartujesz? Spójrz tylko na tę piękną twarz!

source_text: Hahaha!

structure.raw_value: HeHaOpNo3^.Hahaha!
structure.script_literal: "HeHaOpNo3^.Hahaha!"

translation: Hahaha!

source_text: You horny moms going to buy something or just here to make fun of your boy toy?

structure.raw_value: TaFlEx.You horny moms going to buy something or just here to make fun of your boy toy?
structure.script_literal: "TaFlEx.You horny moms going to buy something or just here to make fun of your boy toy?"

translation: Napalona mamuśko, kupisz coś, czy przyszłaś tylko nabijać się ze swojego chłopca-zabawki?

source_text: Well, I hate to interrupt your one-on-one time with your mother.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx^.Well, I hate to interrupt your one-on-one time with your mother.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx^.Well, I hate to interrupt your one-on-one time with your mother."

translation: Nie chcę przerywać wam chwili sam na sam z matką.

source_text: What do you say, 1Hero? Should I buy a toy?

structure.raw_value: HeFlOp^.What do you say, 1Hero? Should I buy a toy?
structure.script_literal: "HeFlOp^.What do you say, 1Hero? Should I buy a toy?"

translation: Co ty na to, 1Hero? Mam kupić zabawkę?

source_text: Maybe you should go to Dick’s.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.Maybe you should go to Dick’s.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.Maybe you should go to Dick’s."

translation: Może powinnaś zajrzeć do Dicka.

source_text: A dick sounds good right about now.

structure.raw_value: HeFlOp^.A dick sounds good right about now.
structure.script_literal: "HeFlOp^.A dick sounds good right about now."

translation: Kutas brzmi teraz całkiem kusząco.

source_text: Heather!

structure.raw_value: McShWo.Heather!
structure.script_literal: "McShWo.Heather!"

translation: Heather!

source_text: Haha. Come on, Heather. Let’s not tease the boy any longer…

structure.raw_value: CaHaExNo3^.Haha. Come on, Heather. Let’s not tease the boy any longer…
structure.script_literal: "CaHaExNo3^.Haha. Come on, Heather. Let’s not tease the boy any longer…"

translation: Haha. Chodź, Heather. Nie dręczmy już chłopaka…

source_text: Besides, I’m getting mighty hungry.

structure.raw_value: CaFlOp^.Besides, I’m getting mighty hungry.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlOp^.Besides, I’m getting mighty hungry."

translation: Poza tym jestem strasznie głodna.

source_text: Saved by Carol’s stomach.

structure.raw_value: HeFlOp^.Saved by Carol’s stomach.
structure.script_literal: "HeFlOp^.Saved by Carol’s stomach."

translation: Uratował cię głód Carol.

source_text: Have fun at lunch.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Have fun at lunch.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Have fun at lunch."

translation: Smacznego.

source_text: Head on over to Heather’s tonight if you want to watch the news broadcast with us.

structure.raw_value: CaHaEx^.Head on over to Heather’s tonight if you want to watch the news broadcast with us.
structure.script_literal: "CaHaEx^.Head on over to Heather’s tonight if you want to watch the news broadcast with us."

translation: Wpadnij dziś wieczorem do Heather, jeśli chcesz obejrzeć z nami wiadomości.

source_text: Yeah, 1Hero. We’d love to have some company.

structure.raw_value: HeFrOp^.Yeah, 1Hero. We’d love to have some company.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrOp^.Yeah, 1Hero. We’d love to have some company."

translation: Tak, 1Hero. Chętnie spędzimy z tobą czas.

source_text: Maybe. I should check up on Chloe and Hannah.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Maybe. I should check up on Chloe and Hannah.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Maybe. I should check up on Chloe and Hannah. "

translation: Może. Powinienem sprawdzić, co u Chloe i Hannah.

source_text: Of course. Spend some time with those girls, 1Hero. It’s good for them.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx^.Of course. Spend some time with those girls, 1Hero. It’s good for them.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx^.Of course. Spend some time with those girls, 1Hero. It’s good for them."

translation: Oczywiście. Spędź trochę czasu z tymi dziewczynami, 1Hero. Dobrze im to zrobi.

source_text: Come on, Heather. Let’s eat.

structure.raw_value: CaFrOp^.Come on, Heather. Let’s eat.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrOp^.Come on, Heather. Let’s eat."

translation: Chodź, Heather. Zjedzmy coś.

source_text: A spy? Really?

structure.raw_value: NeAnDeNo1.A spy? Really?
structure.script_literal: "NeAnDeNo1.A spy? Really?"

translation: Szpiegiem? Naprawdę?

source_text: Either you’re a spy working for Andrea, or I’m arresting you right now.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Either you’re a spy working for Andrea, or I’m arresting you right now.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Either you’re a spy working for Andrea, or I’m arresting you right now."

translation: Albo pracujesz jako szpieg dla Andrei, albo zaraz cię aresztuję.

source_text: Are you dumb? If you’re so sure I’m a spy, then why are you telling the world?

structure.raw_value: NeAnDe.Are you dumb? If you’re so sure I’m a spy, then why are you telling the world?
structure.script_literal: "NeAnDe.Are you dumb? If you’re so sure I’m a spy, then why are you telling the world?"

translation: Zgłupiałeś? Jeśli jesteś pewien, że jestem szpiegiem, to po co rozpowiadasz to wszystkim?

source_text: Did I call your bluff?

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Did I call your bluff?
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Did I call your bluff?"

translation: Przejrzałem cię?

source_text: If you work for the police, shouldn’t you already know my mom’s a spy?

structure.raw_value: TaAnEx.If you work for the police, shouldn’t you already know my mom’s a spy?
structure.script_literal: "TaAnEx.If you work for the police, shouldn’t you already know my mom’s a spy?"

translation: Jeśli pracujesz dla policji, nie powinieneś już wiedzieć, że moja mama jest szpiegiem?

source_text: So, she is?

structure.raw_value: McShOp.So, she is?
structure.script_literal: "McShOp.So, she is?"

translation: Czyli jednak jest?

source_text: You don’t know shit, 1Hero. You have to stay out of this and stop following me around.

structure.raw_value: NeAnEx.You don’t know shit, 1Hero. You have to stay out of this and stop following me around.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnEx.You don’t know shit, 1Hero. You have to stay out of this and stop following me around."

translation: Gówno wiesz, 1Hero. Trzymaj się od tego z daleka i przestań za mną łazić.

source_text: I’m not following you around.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.I’m not following you around.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.I’m not following you around."

translation: Wcale za tobą nie łaziłem.

source_text: You just so happen to keep running into me? You expect me to believe that?

structure.raw_value: NeAnOp.You just so happen to keep running into me? You expect me to believe that?
structure.script_literal: "NeAnOp.You just so happen to keep running into me? You expect me to believe that?"

translation: Tak się przypadkiem na mnie ciągle natykasz? Mam w to uwierzyć?

source_text: I’m trying to solve a mystery, and you seem to be smack dab in the middle of it.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.I’m trying to solve a mystery, and you seem to be smack dab in the middle of it.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.I’m trying to solve a mystery, and you seem to be smack dab in the middle of it."

translation: Próbuję rozwiązać zagadkę, a ty jesteś w samym jej środku.

source_text: Do your job, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: NeAnOp.Do your job, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnOp.Do your job, 1Hero."

translation: Wykonuj swoją robotę, 1Hero.

source_text: This is my job.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.This is my job.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.This is my job."

translation: Właśnie to robię.

source_text: What’s your angle, 1Hero? What are you really trying to do?

structure.raw_value: NeAnDe.What’s your angle, 1Hero? What are you really trying to do?
structure.script_literal: "NeAnDe.What’s your angle, 1Hero? What are you really trying to do?"

translation: O co ci chodzi, 1Hero? Co tak naprawdę próbujesz zrobić?

source_text: There is Guild activity in North Santiva and now it’s my job on the line if anything happens.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.There is Guild activity in North Santiva and now it’s my job on the line if anything happens.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.There is Guild activity in North Santiva and now it’s my job on the line if anything happens."

translation: Gildia działa w North Santiva, a jeśli coś się stanie, to ja stracę pracę.

source_text: It’s your job on the line if the public suspects anything is happening.

structure.raw_value: NeAnDe.It’s your job on the line if the public suspects anything is happening.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnDe.It’s your job on the line if the public suspects anything is happening."

translation: To ty stracisz pracę, jeśli ludzie zaczną coś podejrzewać.

source_text: Tell me, 1Hero. Why do you spend so much time at the Wilkes mansion?

structure.raw_value: NeBaOp.Tell me, 1Hero. Why do you spend so much time at the Wilkes mansion?
structure.script_literal: "NeBaOp.Tell me, 1Hero. Why do you spend so much time at the Wilkes mansion?"

translation: Powiedz mi, 1Hero. Czemu tak często bywasz w rezydencji Wilkesów?

source_text: You’re watching me?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.You’re watching me?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.You’re watching me?"

translation: Obserwujesz mnie?

source_text: I’m watching the mansion.

structure.raw_value: NeBaEx.I’m watching the mansion.
structure.script_literal: "NeBaEx.I’m watching the mansion."

translation: Obserwuję rezydencję.

source_text: I should arrest you right now.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.I should arrest you right now.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.I should arrest you right now."

translation: Powinienem cię teraz aresztować.

source_text: Try it. See what happens.

structure.raw_value: NeAnOp.Try it. See what happens.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnOp.Try it. See what happens."

translation: Spróbuj. Zobaczymy, co się stanie.

source_text: Leave her alone, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: TaAnEx.Leave her alone, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "TaAnEx.Leave her alone, 1Hero."

translation: Zostaw ją w spokoju, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.For all I know, she’s a criminal.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.For all I know, she’s a criminal."

translation: Z tego, co wiem, może być przestępczynią.

source_text: She’s not a criminal. She was let out of prison for a reason.

structure.raw_value: TaAnEx.She’s not a criminal. She was let out of prison for a reason.
structure.script_literal: "TaAnEx.She’s not a criminal. She was let out of prison for a reason."

translation: Nie jest przestępczynią. Wypuszczono ją z więzienia z jakiegoś powodu.
